column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-COVERAGE-2.md item 4. Guards the three insecure opt-ins KEYORIX_ALLOW_INSECURE_SMTP (internal/notifychan, internal/delivery smtp tls=none) and KEYORIX_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOG_DELIVERY (delivery mode=log); all read through Enabled. Zero findings: only ParseBool's six truthy spellings enable; whitespace, other casings, yes/on, numbers other than 1 and full-width/zero-width look-alikes stay off; variable names are exact. Pinned by internal/envflag/envflag_review_test.go:TestEnabled_SpellingTable. New guard :TestInsecureEnvGatesGoThroughEnabled (AST scan: no os.Getenv/LookupEnv of an INSECURE-named variable outside envflag in the root module; matcher self-test is the red case) enforces docs/security/SECURE-CODING.md 6, which said 'how enforced' without a check. Not covered: the cli module's KEYORIX_ALLOW_INSECURE_SECRET_FLAGS gate (separate module, accepts "1" only: stricter, not a bypass), names without INSECURE in them
